title: Baxstar Fishing

services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: Late August is treating anglers well in the 412, and there's a little something for everybody right now. Panfish are the easiest bite to find, walleyes are finally cooperating, and the muskie fishing has been the best it's been in weeks. The crappie bite remains strong in and near shallow weedlines - both near shore and mid lake - and suspended adjacent to deep bars. Plastics are the preferred bait, and that's where the fun starts. You will get a case of "the nibs" - bites and nibbles that never convert to a catch. Loosening your grip on the rod and slowing down your hookset will convert a good share of those, and it's the fix most anglers need most. On my guided trips I add one more
